app.name: TickTack
app.tagline: Plan the day you mean to have.
app.splashLabel: TickTack, plan the day you mean to have. Loading.

states.errorBody: We couldn't load this screen. Your data is safe on this device.
states.comingSoon: This screen arrives in the next build.

today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Choose what fits today. Add a task to shape your day.
today.allDone: Everything planned for today is done.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.emptyBody: Nothing is scheduled on this day yet.
calendar.emptyWeekBody: Nothing is planned for these seven days yet.
calendar.swipeHint_day: Swipe left or right for the next or previous day.
calendar.swipeHint_week: Swipe left or right for the next or previous week.
calendar.swipeHint_month: Swipe left or right for the next or previous month.
calendar.dragHint: Long press, then drag to move it to another time. Or use the move actions or Quick edit.

goals.title: Goals
goals.emptyBody: Set a goal, link the tasks that get you there and watch the percentage grow.
goals.descriptionPlaceholder: Why it matters, how you will get there
goals.currentPeriod: Current period: {{range}}. Progress restarts each period.
goals.noTasksYet: No tasks yet. Create one below.
goals.createTask: Or create a task for this goal
goals.newTaskPlaceholder: For example: Long run on Sunday
goals.needsTaskHint: Link or create at least one task to save this goal.
goals.repeatEndNote: Repeating tasks in a goal can’t run forever: they end on the goal’s due date, or at the end of the current period.
goals.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted on another device.
goals.historyEmpty: Each finished period will show here with the share you reached.
goals.deleteBody_one: Its task is kept and unlinked from the goal.
goals.deleteBody_other: Its {{count}} tasks are kept and unlinked from the goal.
goals.lastTaskBody: After this delete the goal has no tasks left. Archive the goal too, or keep it and add tasks later?
goals.milestonesHint: Checkpoints on the way. The percentage still counts tasks only.
goals.milestonePlaceholder: For example: Finish the first draft

errors.dueRequired: Pick a due date for a one-time goal.
errors.startRequired: Pick when the first period starts.
errors.dueBeforeStart: The due date is before the start.
errors.needsTask: A goal needs at least one task.
errors.lastTask: A goal needs at least one task: add another before removing this one.
errors.saveFailed: The goal could not be saved. Try again.

routines.title: Routines
routines.emptyBody: Build a short routine for your mornings or evenings.
routines.deleteBody: Its schedule and reminder are removed. Runs you already recorded stay in your history.
routines.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted on another device.
routines.stepsHint: Steps run in this order. A duration gives the step a timer.
routines.stepPlaceholder: For example: Drink a glass of water
routines.saveFailed: The run could not be saved. Try again.

errors.needsStep: A routine needs at least one step.
errors.repeatRequired: A routine repeats. Pick how often.
errors.saveFailed: The routine could not be saved. Try again.

me.title: Me
me.guestBody: Your plans stay on this device. Create an account later to sync them.
me.conceptNote: Built to show how VIZAM designs apps. Any demo data is synthetic.
me.guestAccountBody: Create an account to back up and sync your plans. Everything you made as a guest is kept.
me.signOutBody: Your plans are removed from this device. They stay in your account.
me.signOutPending_one: {{count}} change has not reached your account yet and will be lost if you sign out now.
me.signOutPending_other: {{count}} changes have not reached your account yet and will be lost if you sign out now.

editor.titlePlaceholder: What do you want to do?
editor.seriesNote: This task repeats. When you save, choose whether the change applies to this day only, this and the following days, or every occurrence.
editor.deleteBody: It will be removed from all your devices.
editor.orphans_one: {{count}} changed occurrence no longer fits the new schedule and will be removed.
editor.orphans_other: {{count}} changed occurrences no longer fit the new schedule and will be removed.

errors.dateRequiredForRepeat: Pick a date to start repeating from.
errors.dateRequiredForTime: Pick a date before setting a time.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
errors.repeatInvalid: Check the repeat settings (pick at least one day).
errors.saveFailed: The task could not be saved. Try again.
errors.repeatNeverInGoal: A task linked to a goal can’t repeat forever. Choose when it ends.
errors.repeatAfterGoalEnd: The repeat has to end by the goal’s due date.
errors.goalInvalid: Give the goal a name (up to 120 characters).

editor.goalEmpty: No goals yet. Name one to link this task to it.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.previewNone: No upcoming dates with these settings.
repeat.needsDate: Pick a date first to repeat a task.
repeat.endNeverBlocked: Not available for a task linked to a goal.
repeat.goalEndHint: A task linked to a goal can’t repeat forever. It ends by the goal’s due date, {{date}}.
repeat.goalEndHintOpen: A task linked to a goal can’t repeat forever. Choose an end date or a number of times.

auth.signUpBody: Keep your plans safe and in sync.
auth.resetBody: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.
auth.unavailable: Accounts are not available in this build. Your plans stay on this device.
auth.guestMerge_one: {{count}} plan on this device will be added to your account.
auth.guestMerge_other: {{count}} plans on this device will be added to your account.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match. Try again or reset your password.
errors.signUpFailed: We could not create that account. If you already have one, sign in instead.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.requiresRecentLogin: For your security, enter your password again.
errors.unavailable: This is not available right now.

onboarding.step1Title: Plan the day you mean to have
onboarding.step1Body: Choose what fits today and see how full your day is before it starts.
onboarding.step2Body: Short morning and evening routines, ticked off step by step.
onboarding.step3Body: Link tasks to goals and watch the progress add up.
onboarding.readyBody: Start as a guest: everything stays on this device. Create an account any time to sync your plans.
onboarding.guestNote: Guest plans are kept and uploaded when you create an account.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.subtitle: This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.body: Your account, every plan stored in it and the data on this device will be deleted. Enter your password to confirm it is you.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Your account and all your plans will be permanently deleted.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.itemHintUntimed: Rings at a time of day. Add a start time to ring before it instead.
reminders.webUnavailable: Reminders ring on the TickTack mobile app. They are not available on the web.
reminders.deniedBody: Notifications are off for TickTack. Your reminders are saved; turn notifications on to get them.
reminders.beforeDueHint: On the day, the day before or a week before.
reminders.beforeEndHint: Before the end of each period.
reminders.eachStepHint: When each linked task is due.
reminders.monthlyHint: A short nudge on a day of the month.
reminders.primerBody: TickTack only sends the reminders you choose for your goals, tasks and routines, from this phone. Your phone will ask for permission next.
reminders.exactNote: Reminders may arrive a few minutes late on this phone.
reminders.exactBody: Android can delay reminders to save battery. To ring them at the exact minute, TickTack needs “Alarms & reminders” access. Your phone will open that setting next: switch it on for TickTack, then come back. Without it, reminders still arrive, a little later.

notifications.due_0: Due today. You can do it!
notifications.monthly: Monthly check-in: how is this goal going?
notifications.daily: Daily reminder: keep it going today.
notifications.weekly: Weekly reminder: time for this week’s step.

details.seriesNote: This is one day of a repeating task. Edit, Reschedule and Delete ask which days to change.
details.templateNote: This is the repeating task itself. Open one of its days to mark it done.
details.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted or changed on another device.

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.count_one: {{count}} task from before today is still open.
overdue.count_other: {{count}} tasks from before today are still open.
overdue.countCapped: Showing the {{count}} oldest open tasks from before today.
overdue.emptyBody: Every task from before today is done or rescheduled.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Tasks you complete show up here, grouped by day.
history.range: Completed tasks from the last {{days}} days. Missed repeating tasks from the last {{missedDays}} days.

settings.weekStartHint: Used by the calendar, the week views and goal periods.
settings.capacityHint: How much time you plan per day. The workload bar on Today compares your plan with it.
settings.categoriesHint: Add, rename, recolour or delete the groups for your tasks.
settings.remindersOk: Reminders are on and ring at the exact time.
settings.remindersNotAsked: Reminders are off until you add one to a task, goal or routine.

categoriesScreen.title: Categories
categoriesScreen.intro: Categories group your tasks and routines and give them a colour.
categoriesScreen.editHint: Opens the editor to rename, recolour or delete
categoriesScreen.emptyBody: Add one to group your tasks and routines.
categoriesScreen.duplicate: You already have a category with this name.
categoriesScreen.deleteUnused: No task or routine uses this category.
categoriesScreen.deleteBody_one: 1 item uses this category. Where should it go?
categoriesScreen.deleteBody_other: {{count}} items use this category. Where should they go?
categoriesScreen.deleteFailedBody: The category was not deleted. Nothing was changed. Try again.

failedSync.title: Sync problems
failedSync.intro: These changes were refused by your account storage. Retry sends them again; Discard stops trying and keeps the item on this phone.
failedSync.emptyBody: Every change has reached your account or is waiting its turn.
failedSync.discardBody: TickTack stops trying to upload it. The item stays on this device, but this change may never reach your account.

errors.permission-denied: Not allowed by your account rules.
errors.failed-precondition: The server could not accept it yet.
errors.out-of-range: A value was out of range.
errors.invalid-local: This item is damaged on this device and was never sent. Edit it or discard it.
